FN-YMECLNN-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 59
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/19/2026
Senate Bill 59 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of public institutions
of higher education, as well as the Executive Budget Office, to meet the annual reporting
requirements established by the bill with regards to state and federal expenditures and receipts.
